description:
The Matsya Pokhari Yojana is a significant welfare scheme launched by the Government of Assam in India. 

This scheme was officially launched on 10th September 2020. 

The primary objective of the Matsya Pokhari Yojana is to promote fish farming and enhance the livelihood of the rural population in Assam. 

The scheme aims to provide financial assistance to individuals and groups engaged in fish farming. 

The government intends to increase fish production in the state by promoting aquaculture practices. 

The target is to enhance fish production in Assam by 20 percent over the next five years. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana is designed to benefit around 1 lakh fish farmers across the state. 

Under this scheme, the government provides a subsidy of 40 percent on the total cost of fish farming. 

The maximum subsidy amount is capped at INR 2 lakh for each beneficiary. 

This financial assistance is aimed at covering the costs associated with pond construction, fish seed procurement, and feed. 

The scheme also encourages the use of modern technology in fish farming practices. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana is particularly beneficial for marginalized communities and small-scale farmers. 

Eligibility criteria for the scheme include being a resident of Assam. 

Applicants must be engaged in fish farming or intend to start fish farming. 

The age limit for applicants is set at a minimum of 18 years. 

There are no specific educational qualifications required to apply for the scheme. 

However, applicants must demonstrate a basic understanding of fish farming practices. 

The application process for the Matsya Pokhari Yojana involves several steps. 

Interested beneficiaries must first visit the official website of the Assam Fisheries Department. 

They need to download the application form available on the website. 

The completed application form must be submitted to the nearest Fisheries Development Officer. 

Applicants are required to attach certain documents with their application. 

These documents include proof of identity such as an Aadhaar card or voter ID. 

Additionally, applicants must provide proof of residence in Assam. 

A bank account statement or passbook is also required to facilitate subsidy disbursement. 

Once the application is submitted, it undergoes verification by the Fisheries Development Officer. 

The verification process typically takes about 15 to 30 days. 

Upon successful verification, the subsidy amount is sanctioned. 

The disbursement of funds is done directly to the beneficiary's bank account. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana also includes a provision for training and capacity building. 

Beneficiaries are provided with training on modern aquaculture techniques. 

This training is conducted by experts from the Fisheries Department. 

The scheme encourages the establishment of fish farming cooperatives. 

These cooperatives can help in collective marketing and better price realization for fish farmers. 

The government aims to create a sustainable fish farming ecosystem through this initiative. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana is part of the broader Assam State Aquaculture Policy. 

This policy was formulated to enhance fish production and ensure food security in the state. 

The scheme also aligns with the National Fisheries Policy of India. 

The National Fisheries Policy aims to increase fish production in the country to 22 million metric tons by 2025. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana contributes to this national goal by focusing on local production. 

The scheme is expected to generate employment opportunities in rural areas. 

It aims to empower women by promoting their participation in fish farming activities. 

The government has allocated a budget of INR 100 crore for the implementation of the Matsya Pokhari Yojana. 

This budget is intended to cover subsidies and training programs for beneficiaries. 

The scheme is monitored by the Assam Fisheries Department. 

Regular assessments are conducted to evaluate the impact of the scheme on fish production. 

The government encourages feedback from beneficiaries to improve the scheme. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana is expected to have a multiplier effect on the local economy. 

By increasing fish production, it aims to enhance the nutritional status of the population. 

The scheme also promotes sustainable fishing practices to protect aquatic ecosystems. 

The government is committed to ensuring that the benefits reach the intended beneficiaries. 

Regular awareness campaigns are conducted to inform potential beneficiaries about the scheme. 

These campaigns highlight the importance of fish farming as a livelihood option. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana is a crucial step towards achieving self-sufficiency in fish production. 

It aims to reduce the dependence on fish imports and enhance local consumption. 

The scheme is expected to play a vital role in the socio-economic development of rural Assam. 

The government is optimistic about the positive outcomes of the Matsya Pokhari Yojana. 

It is seen as a model for similar initiatives in other states of India. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana reflects the government's commitment to improving the livelihoods of rural communities. 

Through this scheme, the government aims to create a sustainable and prosperous future for fish farmers in Assam. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana is a testament to the potential of aquaculture in transforming rural economies. 

By providing financial support and training, the scheme empowers individuals to take charge of their livelihoods. 

The government continues to explore ways to enhance the effectiveness of the Matsya Pokhari Yojana. 

It is committed to ensuring that the scheme adapts to the changing needs of fish farmers. 

The Matsya Pokhari Yojana is a significant initiative that holds promise for the future of fish farming in Assam.
